historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of an existing two-family dwelling.
An existing two-family dwelling stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the project to construct a new two-family dwelling, with the condition to reduce the height of the stairs at the penthouse.
